newsitem.title: USA: US Midwest hogs called $1.00 lower Monday - trade.
newsitem.headline: US Midwest hogs called $1.00 lower Monday - trade.

text.p: The week-long fall in cash hog prices may extend into Monday, with U.S. Midwest cash hog dealers expecting $1.00 per cwt lower markets then.

Dealers said late this week that hog marketings increased despite the falling prices and there was a large run of hogs Friday in several area. Producers appeared eager to sell hogs before prices fall under $50.00 per cwt, they said. Top prices in Midwest direct markets Friday were $52.50 to $54.00.
On Thursday, hog marketings in some areas exceeded estimates with USDA reporting interior Iowa/southern Minnesota receipts then at 108,000 head versus 100,000 estimated.
Most of Monday's slaughter needs were covered with Friday's hog marketings, they said.
Dealers said hog marketings could slow early next week if cold and snow enter the Midwest. Forecasts have the storm spreading from the Plains area over the western Midwest Monday and Tuesday.
